critical_code_review_comments: server.py L462 (distributor_create_agent): the agent inherits d_admin_pct+d_md_pct as `base` — this is correct only if the distributor's admin_pct never drifts from `MD.commission_percent`. That invariant is upheld by `cascade_md_downstream` when the admin PATCHes MD commission, so it's currently consistent. However, if an operator ever runs a manual mongo update on `users` bypassing the cascade helper, agents created afterwards will have a stale admin_pct. Consider a defensive re-read of `MD.commission_percent` inside distributor_create_agent, or a mongo aggregation-based derivation, to make the write path robust to drift.

server.py L1385-1391 (admin_approve_recharge fallback): the legacy path sets `md_pct=0.0` for records where admin_pct/md_pct/dist_pct are missing. Good — protects historical accuracy. But note: `total_pct` reads `total_commission` first, then `commission_percent` — if a legacy record has only `commission_percent` set but no `total_commission`, the fallback works. Cross-checked spec math: matches 1500/1000/300/200/98500 exactly on pre-seeded recharge, so live path is correct.

server.py L1130 (md_stats): `approved_recharges` count uses `md_id` snapshot on recharges — this is IMMUTABLE and correct. `pending_recharges` uses agent_ids at query time — semantically correct because pending recharges haven't been snapshotted yet. No issue.

server.py L1105-1108 (md_list_agents creator_name): for distributor-created agents the creator_name is looked up from parent_map. If the distributor is soft-deleted (`is_deleted=true`), `_build_parent_name_map` may or may not return the name — worth double-checking that soft-deleted distributors still surface a name (not '—') on the MD's My Agents page for audit clarity. Non-blocking.

server.py L2320-2323 (admin_stats_financial): `total_distributor_earnings` and `total_md_earnings` are always LIFETIME regardless of `range` param — this is intentional and matches Total Wallet Balance behaviour, but the front-end labels 'All time • Live balance' correctly convey this. Confirmed: 3-way sum invariant holds on lifetime scope (admin+md+dist == total_revenue exactly).

server.py L448 (md_create_subuser direct agent): when MD creates a direct agent, `commission_percent` param is the MD's OWN markup (md_pct), not the agent's total — matches spec but the API field name `commission_percent` is misleading; a distinct `md_markup` field on CreateUserIn would be clearer. Non-blocking API-cosmetic.
server.py L1148: `md_freeze` message 'Not found in your downline' — good scoping, matches the 4-tier isolation contract. No issue.

server.py L2318 has redundant `is_deleted: False` in the query for `dist_ids` used in `_distributor_earnings_batch`; earnings computed from approved recharges won't include soft-deleted distributor's downline anyway. Non-blocking.
